cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

mechanism: A evaluates a sibling's confession like an expert appraiser, correcting an undervalued offer before trading their own secret.
confusable: Mere confession sharing differs from explicit price equivalence by punishment; S03 controls the valuation.
comparison: Domestic punishment and a concrete shared accomplice differ from workplace contact brokerage.
seedUse: Keep spare key, unequal confessions and Jamie link; remove detached professional wrappers and make the grading spoken.
